title: Aaha Enna Porutham
desc: A con man's attempt at a rich life takes an odd turn when he becomes a part of a family feud in the village where he sets up his sham.

title: Thalayatti Bommaigal
desc: Mari, a rickshaw driver, finds an innocent child on the road and brings him home. He hires a lady caretaker, leading his lover to misunderstand and decide to leave him.

title: Dharma Chakkaram
desc: Chakkaravarthy loses a challenge with Arumugam, which leads to his girlfriend sacrificing her life. Years later, Chakkaravarthy meets another woman who shares her name with his former lover.

title: Veetla Eli Veliyila Puli
desc: An otherwise confident Purshottaman finds himself completely dominated by his overbearing wife. Desperate to escape his uncomfortable situation, he turns to his colleague, Sivaraman, for help.
